name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Left
description: (Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:movement)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You possess Obito Uchiha's left eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the right eye, you access long-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can create ranged barrier spaces to suck objects and people into Kamui or close the door halfway to kill them, including around yourself. Larger barriers cost more energy.
